QUOTE: The post is written to the local database before the network call, with a `pendingPostId` as its id. ... Any other failure sets `props.failed = true` (line 169) and saves the post locally (lines 183-195). It stays in the channel as a failed post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before sending and that on failure it is kept and marked `failed = true`.
